scope: Bounded public read-only VFAT APR and analytics assessment. No wallet, credential, quote, transaction, installation or live backfill. Provider claims are not independent Domino accounting qualification.

toolSchemas.name: search_yield_opportunities
toolSchemas.title: Search yield opportunities
toolSchemas.description: Searches and ranks VFAT yield opportunities with bounded, model-friendly pagination.

search.description: Free-text token, pool, or protocol search.

items.description: EVM chain ID, for example 1 for Ethereum.

toolSchemas.name: get_pool_history
toolSchemas.title: Get pool analytics and history
toolSchemas.description: Reads scheduled pool analytics for 30 closed UTC days, or hourly swap activity for the last 24 closed hours when the pool has a known age under seven days. Daily data includes TVL and verified fee growth. Missing data never triggers live backfilling.

id.description: Stable VFAT yield option ID returned by opportunity discovery.

bucket.description: Prepared history covers 30 closed UTC days, or 24 closed hours for pools with a known age under seven days.

toolSchemas.name: get_position_performance
toolSchemas.title: Get open-position performance
toolSchemas.description: Gets lineage-aware net PnL, cash flow, ROI/APR percentages, freshness, and PnL availability for open VFAT positions.

adminAddress.description: Wallet that administers the VFAT Sickle positions.

chainId.description: Optionally restrict positions to one chain.

toolSchemas.name: get_position_performance_history
toolSchemas.title: Get position-performance history
toolSchemas.description: Gets bounded PnL, ROI/APR percentages, valuation history, and PnL availability for one lineage.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID, for example 1 for Ethereum.

positionRootTokenId.description: Stable lineage identifier returned by get_position_performance.

requests.curation: Only Robinhood entry retained; other supported chains omitted.
Unrelated aggregate facets omitted. HTTP Date is response time, not an APR data-through timestamp.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search. Whitespace-separated terms match any term; prefix a term with - to exclude matching results. Exclusions take precedence and can be used alone. A standalone - is ignored. Pair, CL tick-spacing, address, and pool ID searches work within each term. Example: cbbtc eth -wsteth.

netCashflowUsd.description: Cumulative external cash flow; this is not booked trading profit.

currentValueUsd.description: Current principal value, excluding pending rewards and estimated swap fees.

totalPnlUsd.description: Net position performance: cumulative external cash flow plus current principal and pending rewards. Estimated swap fees replace pending rewards when rewards are zero or omitted.

pendingRewardsUsd.description: USD value of pending position rewards.

estimatedSwapFeesUsd.description: USD value of estimated uncollected swap fees. Included in current-position total PnL only when pending rewards are zero or omitted.

currentBalanceUsd.description: Current principal value, excluding pending rewards and estimated swap fees.

netCashflowUsd.description: Cumulative external cash flow; this is not booked trading profit.

totalPnlUsd.description: Historical net position performance: cumulative external cash flow plus current principal, excluding pending rewards and estimated swap fees.

pendingRewardsUsd.description: USD value of pending position rewards.

estimatedSwapFeesUsd.description: USD value of estimated uncollected swap fees. Included in current-position total PnL only when pending rewards are zero or omitted.

limitations: Seven-day active-liquidity APR is not pool rolling24h fee APR or actual managed strategy APR.
